intro.text: The cave complex where the kandra people live, in the same mountains as the Pits of Hathsin, close to Luthadel.

description.text: The caverns are larger than the kandra can fill, and some enjoy the solitude after decades away on Contracts. Glowing mushrooms grow throughout. Many tunnels connect to the Pits of Hathsin and are kept blocked and guarded.

The Trustwarren is one of the most important caverns, among the few lit by oil lamps. It is round with metal walls and a low steel platform in the middle with a small hole at its centre. It serves as the meeting hall of the whole kandra people, as a courtroom, and as the home of the Trust.

The Trust is the kandra's name for the Lord Ruler's hoard of atium, hidden beneath the Trustwarren's platform to keep it from Ruin. Most atium mined in the Pits never left the area but was smuggled into the Homeland, and atium paid for Contracts was added to it.
